item: A pass wound down by an exclusive hold no longer starts the detached launches of its tail (preflight job, housekeeping lane, language-detection job, briefing refresh)
summary: The hold winds a pass down within a source but _default_run_once ran its whole tail, and four steps start work that outlives the pass, past the restore's wait for the pass thread: they ran on into the restore's working-copy span with the hold standing (the WAL lane's probe saw the lane and briefing kicks run). Each launch now reads holds_exclusive() for itself and is held back while it stands; the run report says which ones (held_back_by_exclusive_operation) and a log line names them. Nothing is lost: each is re-evaluated at the next pass. Only a HOLD holds them back; a plain Stop keeps its behaviour. Stated limit: check-then-act, so a hold claimed between a launch's read and its start still lets that one through. Eight tests, six red on the unchanged runner; four per-launch mutants red.
